ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 17, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Business Minor students on Monday, April 24, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, September 1, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
